name: api-stability-tier
_stage_vocabulary_ruling: `preview` is DELIBERATELY absent from `stages`, and adding it would break this lane rather than fix it. All 750 registry/catalog/*.yaml declare `api_stability: preview`, so the lane baselines 750 unknown_stage — and THAT frozen count is this lane's only anti-shrink floor: ci/facade/lifecycle-status BaselineStale fires the moment the observed count drops to 749, long before LaneDiscoveredNothing would ever see 0. Legalising `preview` yields a lane with zero violations, hence no shrink floor at all, and converts a measured gap into the fabricated compliance ci/facade/gate-self-conformance/gate-self-conformance-policy.json forbids. Retire the debt by declaring real tiers per crate, never by widening the vocabulary.
purpose: Lifecycle state machine for API stability tier transitions from experimental through removal.
